data.name: DialogAriaLabel
data.value: Move selected photos to a folder

data.name: SubHeading
data.value: Writes the photos you picked into a clean folder. Your source library is untouched unless you choose Move below.

data.name: DestinationHint
data.value: Relative paths are rejected: one would quietly resolve inside the folder you are cleaning.

data.name: TransferModeHint
data.value: Copy — originals stay exactly where they are. Move verifies the hash before removing the source; Hardlink needs one drive.

data.name: RecycleAllSelectedNotice
data.value: Everything is selected, so there is nothing left to recycle.

data.name: RecycleRejectsOne
data.value: Also recycle the {0} photo I didn't pick

data.name: RecycleRejectsMany
data.value: Also recycle the {0} photos I didn't pick

data.name: RecycleRejectsDetail
data.value: Runs only after the files are written and verified. Covers the whole catalogue, not just what is on screen.

data.name: RecycleConfirmOne
data.value: {0} photo ({1}) will go to the Recycle Bin once the move verifies.

data.name: RecycleConfirmMany
data.value: {0} photos ({1}) will go to the Recycle Bin once the move verifies.

data.name: FreeSpaceNotEnough
data.value: {0} free at the destination — not enough

data.name: FreeSpaceUnknown
data.value: Couldn't read free space — the move isn't blocked, but nothing confirmed it will fit.

data.name: HardlinkAvailable
data.value: Hardlinks available — uses no extra space

data.name: HardlinkUnavailable
data.value: Hardlinks unavailable — source and destination are on different drives

data.name: PreflightStaleHint
data.value: Change the destination or structure and this check clears itself — the move can never be armed against a folder nobody verified.

data.name: PreflightPromptHint
data.value: Check the destination first — free space is verified here, not guessed at.

data.name: ErrorRelativePath
data.value: Enter a full path, starting from the root of the drive.

data.name: ErrorMirrorNeedsScan
data.value: Mirror keeps your existing folder structure, so scan the source folder first — or choose By date or Flat.

data.name: ResultMoveRemovedOne
data.value: {0} original was removed from the source folder. Undo it from History.

data.name: ResultMoveRemovedMany
data.value: {0} originals were removed from the source folder. Undo it from History.

data.name: ResultStopped
data.value: Stopped. Photos already written are verified and complete; running it again resumes where it left off.

data.name: ConfirmRemoveBody
data.value: {0} photos will be written to the destination and hash-verified. Remove the originals from the source folder afterwards?

data.name: ConfirmRemoveHint
data.value: Removal runs only after every file is written and verified, and goes to the Recycle Bin — undo it from History.
